# debian/common/tested.txt - optional programs, proven to work on the
# tablet. tools/build_debian.sh asks whether to install them too. Move a
# line to packages.txt to make it part of every card.
#
# Editors
emacs-nox               # Emacs text editor, console version
emacs-common-non-dfsg   # Emacs manuals (C-h i)
elpa-csv-mode           # Emacs: CSV files
elpa-htmlize            # Emacs: export with syntax colours
# Python development
python3-dev             # Python headers, for pip packages with C parts
python3-pip             # pip, Python package installer
python3-venv            # Python virtual environments
python3-textual         # Python: text user interfaces
python3-doc             # Python documentation
python-is-python3       # "python" runs python3
build-essential         # C compiler and make
# Shell tools
git                     # version control
tmux                    # several shells in one console, sessions that survive
ncdu                    # disk usage, interactive
tree                    # folders as a tree
ytree                   # file manager, tree view
bat                     # cat with colours (command: batcat)
btop                    # running programs, CPU, memory, disks
strace                  # trace a program's system calls
sqlite3                 # SQLite database shell
aptitude                # package manager, text menus
dialog                  # dialog boxes for shell scripts
command-not-found       # suggests the package for an unknown command
# Hardware information and development
acpi                    # battery state
upower                  # power and battery information
lm-sensors              # temperatures (sensors)
gpiod                   # GPIO tools (gpioinfo, gpioget)
device-tree-compiler    # dtc: device tree compiler
# Sync, music
syncthing               # keep folders in sync with other devices
alsaplayer-text         # music player in the console
